card.name: Small words after thinks, equivalent, agreement
card.fires_on: Short linking words (to, it, is, might, about) right after a verb or noun that expects a clause or complement, such as 'equivalent', 'thinks', 'as if', 'agreement'.

modes.label: Complement after equivalent/agreement
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'about' follows 'equivalent' or 'no general agreement'.
modes.example: is considered to be equivalent<< to>> missing dose(s) of oral contracept

modes.label: Subject or verb after thinks/as if
modes.description: A pronoun or 'is' begins an embedded clause after 'thinks' or 'as if'.
modes.example: Your brain is fooled into filling in the gaps and thinks<< it>> is seeing real movement.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words for duration and prior events, and suppresses words meaning 'because' and 'at least', so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words that come just before the rest of a clause or comparison.
